system.description:
Change a [Melee Attack] of [Target: Single] to [Target: Wide 1 (P)] for this main process. 

(Fate 1): Change the skill's Timing to [Instant].

A special skill that heightens fighting spirit and fires a sword flash like a whirlwind to mow down a large number of enemies at once. It is one of the special moves that can be said to be synonymous with <Samurai>.
